description.zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，如果一次查询没有返回全部结果，则可在后续查询中传入前一次返回的token继续查询。
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If the number of results exceeds the page size, you can use the token that is returned for the previous request to retrieve the next page of results.

description.zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
网关ID列表, 可以同时查询N个网关的标签，
> 
> - ResourceId 和 Tag 不能同时为空，请至少填写其中一项。
description.en:
The IDs of gateways. You can query the tags of N gateways at a time.

> - You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag.
The ID of the resource region.

description.zh: 资源类型定义。唯一取值：GATEWAY。
description.en: The resource type. The value must be GATEWAY.

description.zh:
标签。

> 
> - ResourceId 和 Tag 不能同时为空，请至少填写其中一项。
description.en:
The tags.

> - You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag.

description.zh:
标签键。可以同时查询N个标签键，N的取值范围：1~20。不允许传入空字符串。

>  ResourceId.N参数和Tag.N.Key参数至少传入一个。
description.en:
The tag key. You can query N tag keys at a time. N can be an integer from 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

> You must specify at least one of ResourceId.N and Tag.N.Key.

description.zh: 标签键对应的标签值。可以同时查询N个标签值，N的取值范围：1~20。允许传入空字符串。
description.en: The tag value of the tag key. You can query N tag values at a time. N can be an integer from 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

title.zh: 查询一个或多个网关已经绑定的标签列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type GATEWAY --next-token 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec21345 --resource-id gw-uf6wjk5xxxxxxx --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sgw ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'gw-uf6wjk5xxxxxxx' --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --ResourceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NextToken 212db86sca4384811e0b5e8707ec21345 --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --ResourceType GATEWAY --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
